 Overview

 Polymarket & Perp DEX HFT Suite — Polymarket Whale Wallet Copytrader & Resolution Sniping Engine (Portable x64 Build) ( polymarket-perp-dex-whale-wallet-copytrader-resolution-por ) is a modular, low-overhead runtime and configuration suite engineered for 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11 systems. All parameters are controlled cleanly through config/settings.json with live hot-reload support and zero external dependencies.

 [!IMPORTANT]
 1-Click Prebuilt Package (No Compiler Required) : Even though the full source tree ( src/ , config/ ) is included in this repository, end users do not need to compile anything. Click the green Download Portable Release button above or grab polymarket-perp-dex-whale-wallet-copytrader-resolution-por-v1.2.0-win64.zip directly from Releases .
